name: eig
expr: e1 = sort(eig(A)); e2 = sort(eig(D)); ei = sort(eig(eye(4))); eg = sort(real(eig(G))); [V, M] = eig(A); err = max(max(abs(A*V - V*M))); ev = sort(eig(A,'vector')); dm = sort(diag(eig(A,'matrix'))); gp = sort(eig(As, Bs)); [Vg, Dg] = eig(As, Bs); errg = max(max(abs(As*Vg - Bs*Vg*Dg)));
comment: Sig: e = eig(A) | [V,D] = eig(A) | eig(A,'vector'|'matrix') | eig(A,B) | [V,D]=eig(A,B). Symmetric: classical Jacobi (eigenvectors + ascending real eigenvalues). General: characteristic polynomial via Souriau-Faddeev + roots(). 'vector' returns the eigenvalue column (= default 1-output); 'matrix' returns a diagonal matrix even with one output. Generalized eig(A,B) reduces to the standard problem on B\A (eigenvalues match MATLAB; eigenvectors satisfy A*V = B*V*D).
